articles.title: Brawl Vice, a GTA season in Brawl Stars: Crime & justice skins, game modes
articles.summary: Time to unleash your rebellious side, as the Grand Theft Brawl season turns Starr Park into the iconic city of chaos.
body: A new season hits Brawl Stars on Nov. 5, and it’s a GTA-inspired adventure taking over Starr Park!
Play matches to progress through the Brawl Vice Pass and unlock plenty of valuable rewards, including unique Grand Theft skins. Jump into limited-time game modes as part of the seasonal chaos.
Read on to discover all the essential details about the Brawl Vice season, the available skins and how to unlock them, can’t-miss in-game events, and more.

Grand Theft Auto VI ( GTA 6 ) is a highly anticipated game scheduled for release on Nov. 19. To celebrate this new installment in the legendary series, Brawl Stars invites players into a GTA-inspired season!

articles.title: Giant Evolution - November 2026 (Season 89)
articles.summary: November is a quite unusual season, as it doesn’t bring any new Heroes. The last time this happened was in July, for the season focused around Ronin. This season will instead feature 2 new evolutions: Giant and Mirror.
